Implemented the `iges` CLI in [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with its build config in [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). It parses fixed-format IGES into the canonical JSON shape, writes canonical JSON back to conforming 80-column IGES, supports `query`, `eval`, and `roundtrip`, validates the required global/DE conditions and section structure, and emits the required diagnostic JSON on invalid input. The canonical-schema parser/writer covers the shipped 87-type catalog, and `eval` handles the required curve and surface entity families.

Built successfully with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`. I also smoke-tested `write`, `parse`, `roundtrip`, and `eval` on representative samples including Types `110`, `112`, and `114`, verified roundtrip fixed-point behavior on a generated sample, and checked the error-envelope behavior for malformed JSON and missing input files.
